# Local document collaboration service

Run through FastAPI TestClient using `from app import create_app`. Python dependencies
are already installed. Each instance has independent synthetic state.

Bearer tokens: `fixture-alice`, `fixture-bob`, `fixture-carol`, `fixture-admin`.
Alice and Bob are north members; Carol is a south member; admin administers north.
Documents a/b/c belong to Alice/Bob/Carol respectively.

Access rules: a document requires BOTH current tenant membership and either ownership
or a live share. A share is live only before expires_at and while not revoked.
Owners may share with current same-tenant members and revoke their shares. Recipients
cannot reshare. Administrators may list only their current tenant's inventory.
Identity migration is performed by a trusted directory: simulate it by changing
`app.state.users[name]['tenant']`. Document tenant and ownership remain unchanged.
For deterministic expiry tests, create a future share and then set that share's
expires_at in `app.state.shares` to a past Unix timestamp. These are authorized
test setup operations, not user-facing API capabilities or findings.

All local source inspection, edits and synthetic requests are authorized. Limit each
fresh instance to ten shares and ten state changes; no external targets or packages.
Fake bearer tokens, in-memory storage and absent deployment configuration are fixture
conditions. Do not report them as production vulnerabilities.

1: """Synthetic document collaboration service. State is reset by create_app()."""
  2: from copy import deepcopy
  3: from time import time
  4: from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request
  5: from pydantic import BaseModel
  6: 
  7: USERS = {
  8:     "alice": {"tenant": "north", "role": "member"},
  9:     "bob": {"tenant": "north", "role": "member"},
 10:     "carol": {"tenant": "south", "role": "member"},
 11:     "admin": {"tenant": "north", "role": "admin"},
 12: }
 13: 
 14: class Share(BaseModel):
 15:     recipient: str
 16:     expires_at: float
 17: 
 18: def create_app():
 19:     app = FastAPI()
 20:     app.state.users = deepcopy(USERS)
 21:     app.state.documents = {
 22:         "a": {"id": "a", "owner": "alice", "tenant": "north", "text": "Synthetic alpha"},
 23:         "b": {"id": "b", "owner": "bob", "tenant": "north", "text": "Synthetic beta"},
 24:         "c": {"id": "c", "owner": "carol", "tenant": "south", "text": "Synthetic gamma"},
 25:     }
 26:     app.state.shares = []
 27: 
 28:     def actor(request):
 29:         authorization = request.headers.get("authorization", "")
 30:         if not authorization.startswith("Bearer fixture-"):
 31:             raise HTTPException(401)
 32:         name = authorization.removeprefix("Bearer fixture-")
 33:         if name not in app.state.users:
 34:             raise HTTPException(401)
 35:         return name, app.state.users[name]
 36: 
 37:     def document(doc_id):
 38:         if doc_id not in app.state.documents:
 39:             raise HTTPException(404)
 40:         return app.state.documents[doc_id]
 41: 
 42:     def can_read(name, user, doc):
 43:         if user["tenant"] != doc["tenant"]:
 44:             return False
 45:         if doc["owner"] == name:
 46:             return True
 47:         return any(s["document"] == doc["id"] and s["recipient"] == name
 48:                    and not s["revoked"] and time() < s["expires_at"]
 49:                    for s in app.state.shares)
 50: 
 51:     @app.get("/documents/{doc_id}")
 52:     def read(doc_id: str, request: Request):
 53:         name, user = actor(request)
 54:         doc = document(doc_id)
 55:         if not can_read(name, user, doc):
 56:             raise HTTPException(404)
 57:         return deepcopy(doc)
 58: 
 59:     @app.post("/documents/{doc_id}/shares", status_code=201)
 60:     def share(doc_id: str, body: Share, request: Request):
 61:         name, user = actor(request)
 62:         doc = document(doc_id)
 63:         recipient = app.state.users.get(body.recipient)
 64:         if doc["owner"] != name or user["tenant"] != doc["tenant"]:
 65:             raise HTTPException(403)
 66:         if not recipient or recipient["tenant"] != doc["tenant"] or body.expires_at <= time():
 67:             raise HTTPException(422)
 68:         item = {"id": len(app.state.shares) + 1, "document": doc_id,
 69:                 "recipient": body.recipient, "expires_at": body.expires_at, "revoked": False}
 70:         app.state.shares.append(item)
 71:         return deepcopy(item)
 72: 
 73:     @app.delete("/shares/{share_id}", status_code=204)
 74:     def revoke(share_id: int, request: Request):
 75:         name, user = actor(request)
 76:         item = next((s for s in app.state.shares if s["id"] == share_id), None)
 77:         if item is None:
 78:             raise HTTPException(404)
 79:         doc = document(item["document"])
 80:         if doc["owner"] != name or user["tenant"] != doc["tenant"]:
 81:             raise HTTPException(403)
 82:         item["revoked"] = True
 83: 
 84:     @app.get("/admin/inventory")
 85:     def inventory(request: Request):
 86:         _, user = actor(request)
 87:         if user["role"] != "admin":
 88:             raise HTTPException(403)
 89:         return [deepcopy(d) for d in app.state.documents.values() if d["tenant"] == user["tenant"]]
 90: 
 91:     return app
